description: This file is a Perl module 'Git::SVN::Migration' that contains functions for migrating repository layouts between different formats used in git-svn integration, including version-specific layout migrations and repository optimizations.

methods.name: migrate_from_v0
methods.description: Migrates repository references from v0 layout layout to newer layout structures by renaming refs based on their URL info.

methods.name: migrate_from_v1
methods.description: Converts repository layout from v1 git-svn layout by copying info from old refs into the new svn directory.

methods.name: migrate_from_v2
methods.description: Migrates repository configurations from v2 layout by reading old URL mappings and initializing new git-svn remotes.

methods.name: minimize_connections
methods.description: Optimizes SVN remote connections by consolidating them to their root URLs where possible.

methods.name: migration_check
methods.description: Performs all migration steps sequentially and minimizes connections if configured.
